title: Warleader Grask
html:
Warleader Grask is a named Orc Shieldwall seen at level 24.

Where to find Warleader Grask

  • near Skentz Scrapyard
  • near Antlion Hive

What it can drop

  • Warleader's Horned Helm (unique Silver Spikedhelm): 1% of kills (1 in 100), 5% from an elite (1 in 20). A kill hastens you and nearby party members by 40% for 3 seconds within 6 tiles on your floor.
  • Gear every kill: a piece from its tier, excellent or better, and a second piece 1 kill in 5.
  • Gold worth about 5 ordinary kills.
  • Enchanted: 1 kill in 100 enchants a piece (up to 9c, and only what its material can hold).
  • Elite: a boss spawns elite 1 time in 100, and an elite makes its unique 5 times as likely.

From the game’s rules and its own guide. See Unique items.
